channel.title: US Top News and Analysis
channel.description: CNBC is the world leader in business news and real-time financial market coverage. Find fast, actionable information.

item.title: The July jobs numbers are due out Friday. Here's what to expect
item.description: Nonfarm payrolls are expected to post a gain of just 83,000 with an unchanged unemployment rate at 4.2%.

item.title: Solar stocks shine after Trump extends China tariffs to polysilicon products
item.description: Solar stocks rose in premarket trading President Donald Trump announced fresh import restrictions on polysilicon products.

item.title: Oil rises as Iran's draft plan sees U.S. and Israel banned from Strait of Hormuz
item.description: News of Iran's restrictive draft plan for the Strait of Hormuz sent oil prices higher, renewing concerns over supply disruptions.

item.title: Iran's chief negotiator accuses Trump of 'theater diplomacy' with Hormuz traffic near standstill
item.description: The conflict is broadening across the region, with Gulf energy infrastructure and key shipping chokepoints under renewed threat.

item.title: This building materials stock has a favorable setup and a breakout could be in the cards, charts show
item.description: Owens Corning lacks the volatile ride of a tech stock, but it has a risk/reward potential that patient investors should crave.

item.title: Virginia governor to intervene in NextEra, Dominion merger over electricity price concerns
item.description: Virginia's State Corporation Commission is tasked with reviewing the deal and will either accept, reject or impose conditions on it.

item.title: Fox won't renegotiate NFL media rights before current deal expires, CEO Lachlan Murdoch says
item.description: Fox has decided not to renegotiate its current TV deal with the NFL until the expiration of the league's opt-out clause in 2030, said CEO Lachlan Murdoch.

item.title: Grindr's AI spend is paying off and its pricey new tier has had some surprises, CEO says
item.description: Grindr says AI is boosting engineering productivity, supporting a new $350-per-month premium tier and driving stronger subscriber growth and retention.

item.title: SK Hynix to invest $38 billion building new memory chip plants as demand soars
item.description: Memory prices have surged because of short supply and huge demand with investors watching closely for any changes to the supply-demand imbalance.

item.title: Sweetgreen cuts full-year outlook as cyclospora fears weigh on sales
item.description: The salad chain has not been implicated in the ongoing cyclospora outbreak.

item.title: The 72-hour crisis that could upend Meta’s business in India as firm risks losing legal protection
item.description: U.S. social media giant Meta is facing increasing pressure from Indian regulators, including demands to revoke the firm's safe harbor immunity in the country.

item.title: Gas prices could remain high this fall even if crude prices stabilize. Here's why
item.description: The refining market is very tight due to the Ukraine and Iran wars, keeping gas prices elevated even as crude prices fall.

item.title: Jim Cramer highlights 5 investing themes — and the stocks to buy for each
item.description: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said earnings season reinforced five investing themes he thinks will produce the market's best buying opportunities.

item.title: Meta ordered to pay $567 million into abatement fund as remedy to child harms case in New Mexico
item.description: A judge in New Mexico ordered Meta to pay $567 million into an abatement fund after a jury ruled the company violated the state’s unfair practices act.

item.title: Analysis: Trump treats Fed Chairman Kevin Warsh as an ally. That creates economic risks
item.description: Trump's reported phone calls to the Fed chairman will complicate his efforts to prove he will act independently on inflation and interest rates.

item.title: American Airlines will stop upgrading elite flyers to business from coach on long domestic flights
item.description: American Airlines will no longer give elite frequent flyers free upgrades from economy class to business on some of its longest domestic routes

item.title: Sen. Mitch McConnell says he's left rehab, will work from home
item.description: "On the advice of my doctors, I'll maintain an intensive regimen of physical therapy from home during the state work period," the 84-year-old McConnell said.

item.title: Savers Value Village thrift store launches new AI tool to price items
item.description: Savers Value Village is launching a new AI pricing tool to keep product prices consistent and low, the company told CNBC exclusively.

item.title: AMD buys chip startup that hardwires AI models into its silicon
item.description: Taalas' current chip runs a small version of Meta's Llama 3.1, though the company is working on chips for bigger and more advanced models.

item.title: We're adding a critical enabler of AI computing to our Bullpen watchlist
item.description: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.

item.title: GAO finds Elon Musk's DOGE inflated claims of $110 billion in savings for federal government
item.description: The nonpartisan watchdog found Elon Musk's DOGE didn't cut as much federal spending as it claimed and that it fell far short of its promised $2 trillion.

item.title: What is a data breach? The best tools to protect yourself after a cyberattack
item.description: Cybersecurity incidents have reached record highs in the U.S. What does it mean if you've been caught up in a data breach — and how can you get help?

item.title: Airbnb stock soars 9% on earnings and revenue beat, strong guidance for third quarter
item.description: Airbnb said it's seeing strong demand "across all regions," contributing to the company's better-than-expected forecast.

item.title: Yen rally fades a week after U.S.-Japan intervention as focus shifts to policy
item.description: The coordinated involvement from the Treasury and BoJ had initially lifted the yen as low as 155 to the dollar, down from just above 163 beforehand.

item.title: Wildfire costs are surging — but much of the damage in Europe isn’t insured
item.description: Insurers warn that Europe is facing a "protection gap" in wildfire cover as disaster recovery costs outpace insurance coverage.

item.title: From birth to brokerage: Why South Korea is seeing a surge in infant investment accounts
item.description: South Korean babies are turning into mini shareholders, thanks to their parents' investment strategies.

item.title: China's exports growth beats estimates in July, as AI-driven shipments surge
item.description: China's exports rose more than expected in July, as global demand for high-tech components continues to absorb the country's manufactured goods.

item.title: Inside India newsletter: What's behind India’s rush to sell shares in state-owned firms
item.description: India is ramping up stake sales in state-owned companies to keep the growth engine running amid growing fiscal constraints

item.title: SpaceX shares passed a key test Thursday. Now sophisticated traders are betting the bottom may be in
item.description: Shares of Elon Musk's rocket company were trading higher in Thursday's session even as a key lock-up provision expired.

item.title: Situational Awareness wasn't the only one that had a bad July. Hedge funds took a historical hit last month
item.description: Tech-focused hedge funds lost 10.2% of their value in July, making it the worst month on record for the category, JPMorgan found.
